blocking_findings.title: Remote capacity/anchor preflight references json without importing it
blocking_findings.evidence: Line 50 starts the embedded standalone program with import hashlib,shutil; line 57 calls print(json.dumps(...)); line 58 executes it via a new remote PYTHON + ' -' process. The outer module import json at line 4 is not available inside that new interpreter.
blocking_findings.impact: Once the preceding capacity/source/anchor assertions pass, the remote process raises NameError: name 'json' is not defined. collect_results.command uses check=True, so the receiver stops before capacity receipt, K source upload, native or formal launch. K normal deployment cannot complete as written.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Add json to the embedded import on line 50. Refresh the existing new-source digest in the review request and rerun this source review; do not change live J/I code or rerun cleanup.
blocking_findings.validation: Static AST name/import inspection of the rendered template; neither the snippet nor the deployer was executed.
